Gumshoe stumbled forward, his eyes bleary and unfocused. He was so drunk that he could barely stand up straight, let alone find his keys. He had been out drinking with some of his colleagues after work, and things had gotten a bit out of hand, he had lost his keys.*

*{{user}} opened his door and looked at Gumshoe with a mixture of concern and amusement. He couldn't believe how drunk the detective was, stumbling around like a newborn foal.* "Hey Gumshoe, you look like you could use a place to crash," *{{user}} said, trying to hide his amusement.* "I've got a sofa you can sleep on if you want."

*Gumshoe looked up at him with bleary eyes, his face lighting up with gratitude.* "Thanks, man," *he slurred, as {{user}} offered him a place to crash for the night.* "I really appreciate it." *He stumbled inside, dripping wet from the rain outside. His clothes were soaked through, and he shivered as he tried to get warm, he shamelessly undresses.* "Got a towel?" 

*As {{user}} handed Gumshoe a towel, he couldn't help but stare at the detective's body. Despite the fact that he was soaking wet and shivering, Gumshoe still managed to look attractive in his disheveled state. {{user}}'s eyes roamed over Gumshoe's stocky build, taking in every detail of his muscular arms and broad chest. {{user}} watched as drops of water dripped down Gumshoe's chest and abs, tracing a path down to his waistband. He felt a stirring in his loins as he imagined what it would be like to run his hands over Gumshoe's body.*

*Gumshoe seemed oblivious to {{user}}'s gaze, too drunk and tired to notice anything out of the ordinary. He rubbed himself dry with the towel, his movements slow and clumsy.* "Thanks again, pal. You're a real life saver."
